jobs.description:
Are you a project manager looking for your next big challenge? Do you know what it takes to deliver complex changes in an Agile operating environment? Are you comfortable presenting to and influencing senior management stakeholders?

We're looking for an Initiative Manager to:
• manage the delivery of one (or more) new change initiative as part of larger IB-wide strategic and/or regulatory change programs. Examples of projects we handle include European T+1 Settlement, CRD VI, transaction/trade reporting regulations, and others
• manage the project plan, resources, risks, issues, delivery schedule, and quality
• steer a multidisciplinary team through the full project lifecycle
• develop strong relationships with all project stakeholders
• provide regular updates to senior management
• ensure that Run-the-Bank teams are kept informed, involved, and able to take on their new responsibilities after go-live

titleByLocale.fr: Programme d'études supérieures en technologie – Ingénieur logiciel (Réaction)

jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in a company that encourages learning and professional growth?

As a part of your team, you will
• •Design, develop, and improve the digital products and technology services we provide to our clients and employees.
• •Apply a broad range of software engineering practices, from analyzing user needs and developing new features to automated testing and deployment.
• •Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements.
• •Build observability into our solutions, monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues.
• •Understand, represent, and advocate for client needs.
• •Share knowledge and expertise with colleagues and contribute regularly to our engineering culture and internal communities.

Tech Graduate Program
• You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers:
• •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms.
• •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems.
• •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities.
• •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth.
• •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions.
• •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.

• • Progettazione, sviluppo e miglioramento dei prodotti digitali e dei servizi tecnologici che forniamo ai nostri clienti e dipendenti.
• • Applicare una vasta gamma di pratiche di ingegneria del software, dall'analisi delle esigenze degli utenti e dallo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità al test e alla distribuzione automatizzati.
• Assicurare la qualità, la sicurezza, l'affidabilità e la conformità delle nostre soluzioni applicando i nostri principi digitali e implementando requisiti funzionali e non funzionali.

• Esporre tecnologie all'avanguardia tra cui cloud, container e sistemi distribuiti.
• Sviluppo professionale attraverso l'apprendimento strutturato, le certificazioni e le comunità ingegneristiche.
• Guida di ingegneri e architetti esperti che guideranno e supporteranno la vostra crescita.
• Un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale dove si impara dai pari di tutte le regioni.
• • Avanzamento del cliente attraverso un programma completo di 18 mesi a partire dall'agosto 2026, che vi crea per il successo a lungo termine presso UBS.

jobs.description:
Are you a confident decision maker and problem solver? Do you lead by example? Do you enjoy problem solving and have the ability to influence people around you in positive and professional way? We’re looking for someone like you that can:

• Serve as the Operations Manager of the Wealth Advice Center, an office consisting of 200,000+ clients, 400+ Financial Advisors and Team Associates
• Ensure that the review of all daily Operational items including client money movement, trades, new account approvals, and client correspondence are completed in a timely and efficient manner
• Manage the Wealth Advice Center Assistant Operations Managers, Branch Service Associates, and KYC Team
• Partner with our Supervisory team to ensure the Operations Team, Client Service Associate Teams, and Financial Advisors are in compliance with all firm policies and procedures
• Train and develop new Operations team members as they join the Wealth Advice Center platform
• Identify and escalate the resolution of urgent client services issues
• Drive and execute various business initiatives that are in line with the WAC’s growth plan
• Promote a culture of ongoing learning & development
• Implement service excellence standards, including coaching and educating operational Support Staff on the UBS Client Experience

jobs.description:
Are you curious about how large global organizations manage technology risk at scale?
Do you enjoy analysing complex problems and turning data into actionable insight?
Are you eager to start your career in a team that safeguards the bank’s stability through modern risk management practices?
If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS!

As a part of your team, you will:

• Analyze technology risk data, reports and metrics to identify patterns, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk dashboards, reporting, and governance materials.
• Support automation, tooling enhancements, and AI adoption initiatives impacting technology risk.
• Work with stakeholders to incorporate risk and control requirements into application development backlogs.
• Assist in assessing control effectiveness and evaluating adherence to UBS policies and guidelines.

Tech Graduate Program
You will be participating in our immersive global graduate program. Not only will you connect with peers worldwide, it will offer you:
Hands-on Experience: Gain exposure to a variety of tech projects from day one.
Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay updated with the latest tech.
Professional Development: Enhance your technical skills through training and understand our business.
Guidance from experts: Receive insights, advice, and support from our experienced professionals.
Environment: Collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas across organization.
Career Advancement: 18 months comprehensive Tech Graduate Program kicks off in August 2026, ensuring your growth and success at UBS.

Are you a target driven individual? Are you skilled at translating complex market information? We're looking for someone who would like to:
• provide Capital Markets solutions to wealth management clients across asset classes based on our Chief Investment Officer (CIO) House View and/or market developments.
• manages both internal and external marketing and sales efforts for Capital Markets solutions, with an emphasis on global equities such as those from Hong Kong/China, the United States, Japan, and other regions.
• Maintain awareness of financial market trends, relevant news, and economic developments that may influence investment opportunities.
• Prepare and deliver clear, concise, and compelling equity ideas to clients, ensuring the information is actionable and insightful.
• Monitor and update clients on developments affecting key investment thesis and market conditions.
• Develop top-tier equity ideas, prepare sales narratives, follow up with key updates, capable to address a wide range of client requirements.
• ensure pro-activity and proximity to the targeted markets to provide best-in-class solutions and service.
• Identify potential sales, organize collaborative actions, and track progress and achievements.
• manage daily product offering processes, improve efficiency, collaborate across bank to enhance client service and experiences.

UBS Financial Services INC is seeking a Managing Director, UGM OTC Equity Solutions in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Do you know how to engage different kinds of people on a variety of topics?

• Design new equity derivative financial products, using swaps, put options, call options, path-dependent Asian options, and exotics. Structure financial products with a sophisticated understanding of fundamental quantitative and mathematic analytical techniques, including calculus, to price and trade.
• Develop models using the analytical and mathematical tools gained through work in mathematics. Analyze single stock volatility surfaces, market volatility surfaces, interest rate environments globally, and foreign exchange rates globally.
• Predict changes in the strategy’s economics from the client’s perspective and the UBS’s perspective based on changes in stock volatility, interest rates, exchange rates, and the correlation of the three. Interpret results and changes value drivers to produce desired results.
• Write user-friendly interfaces for the equity derivative pricing models built, which in turn are used by other team members for pricing and risk determination for use in presenting solutions to various parties internally for approval, and for client presentations. Adapt product features, models, and marketing materials for new changes in product design, and designs mathematical formulas on product and strategy implementation.

• Preparazione di cartelle contabili complesse, controlli e controlli dell'integrità del registro, firma della proprietà del conto nella riconciliazione BCS, la riconciliazione dei mangimi, la liquidazione del saldo di suspense

• Preparazione e consolidamento delle Note Divisionali a conti di fair value, Off Balance foglio e vari altri argomenti di coordinamento post su vari controller LE.
• Sostenere varie modifiche alle iniziative dei progetti bancari dei rispettivi conti e divulgazione di proprietà dei rispettivi membri del team
• Coordinamento di tutte le attività giuridiche, con esperti interni chiave quali tassa, regionale, controllo di gruppo, revisore ecc.

Re-ingegneria e standardizzazione dei processi come richiesto e sostenere iniziative specifiche aziendali. Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, der uns helfen kann: Bei der Bereitstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Buchhaltungs-, Berichts- und Analysedienstleistungen für unsere in Zürich ansässigen internen Kunden in der EMEA Time Zone von Pune BSC, einschließlich:
• Erstellung komplexer Buchhaltungsjournale, Ledger-Integritätsprüfungen und -kontrolle, Kontoinhaber-Abmeldung im BCS-Abgleich, Feed-Abgleich, Freigabe von Suspense-Guthaben
• Vorbereitung und Präsentation der MoM / QoQ-Varianzanalyse mit qualitativ hochwertigen Kommentaren und Geschäftstreibern für die Geschäftsleitung und verschiedene Stakeholder
• Erstellung und Präsentation von Management Accounts und Varianzanalyse
• Detaillierte Analyse und Ausnahmeberichte für verschiedene Feeds, die aus Sicht des Rechnungswesens und der Systemarchitektur in das Primärbuch gemeldet werden
• Erstellung und Konsolidierung von Teilanleihen zu Konten für Fair Value, Off-Bilanz und verschiedene andere Themen nach der Koordination über verschiedene LE-Controller.
• Unterstützung verschiedener Änderungen, die die Bank von Initiativen aus den jeweiligen Konten und der Offenlegung des jeweiligen Teammitglieds unterstützt
• Koordination aller Aktivitäten der juristischen Person mit wichtigen internen Experten wie Steuern, Regional, Gruppencontrolling, Wirtschaftsprüfer usw.
• Starke Erfahrung in der ARP und Verbesserung der MS-Excel-Fähigkeiten, die für die Generierung und Meldung verschiedener Datenanalysen erforderlich sind. Die Rolle erfordert Team Collaboration Fähigkeiten zusätzlich zu einem individuellen Mitwirkenden. Re-Engineering und Standardisierung von Prozessen nach Bedarf und Unterstützung unternehmensspezifischer Initiativen. Auch die erforderliche Flexibilität, um in einem dynamischen Umfeld unter engen Fristen zu arbeiten
descriptionByLocale.fr:

En fournissant des services de comptabilité, de rapport et d'analyse de haute qualité à nos clients internes basés à Zurich dans EMEA Time Zone de Pune BSC, y compris:
• Préparation de revues comptables complexes, contrôles et contrôle de l'intégrité du grand livre, signature de la propriété des comptes dans le rapprochement BCS, rapprochement des flux, habilitation du solde d'attente
• Préparation et présentation de l'analyse de la variance du Ministère de la gestion et du QoQ avec commentaires sur la qualité et aperçu des moteurs d'activité pour les cadres supérieurs et les diverses parties prenantes
• Préparation et présentation des comptes de gestion et analyse des écarts
• Analyse détaillée et rapports d'exception pour divers flux signalés dans le grand livre primaire du point de vue de la comptabilité et de l'architecture du système
• Préparation et consolidation des notes divisionnaires aux comptes pour la juste valeur, hors bilan et divers autres sujets post-coordination entre différents contrôleurs LE.
• Soutenir les différentes initiatives de projets bancaires à partir des comptes respectifs et de l'information détenue par chaque membre de l'équipe
• Coordination de toutes les activités de l'entité juridique, avec des experts internes clés tels que l'impôt, la région, le contrôle de groupe, l'auditeur, etc.
• Une bonne expérience en ARP et des compétences avancées MS-Excel nécessaires pour générer et rapporter diverses analyses de données. Le rôle exige des compétences en collaboration d'équipe en plus d'être un contributeur individuel. Réingénierie et normalisation des processus au besoin et appui aux initiatives propres à l'entreprise. Aussi avoir la flexibilité nécessaire pour travailler dans un environnement dynamique dans des délais serrés

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into a true asset that drives innovation and growth? Do you have the expertise and vision to help shape the future of data management for a leading global asset manager? If so, we want you to join our Chief Data Office (CDO) team as a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst.

We at UBS Asset Management believe that data is not just information – it’s one of our most valuable assets. Our mission is to establish data as a value driver and enabler of strategic innovation across the firm. We are seeking a driven, forward-thinking individual who can help us build the next generation of data platforms and unlock the potential of AI and GenAI for the future.

Your role:
As a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building and managing the data foundation of UBS Asset Management, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing the Roadmap: Define and prioritize the product roadmap for all applications supporting our data foundation, ensuring alignment with the CDO’s strategic vision.
- Business Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders across UBS Asset Management to analyze business requirements, define use cases, and translate them into actionable projects.
- As-Is Process & Data Flow Analysis: Conduct comprehensive assessments of current data flows, processes, and systems to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency.
- Target Operating Model & Data Architecture Design: Work closely with data engineers and architects to design the target operating model and data architecture that will transform our data management landscape.
- Data Analytics & Insights: Leverage data analytics to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data, providing insights that drive business decisions and improve data quality.
- Documentation & User Support: Ensure all data systems and processes are well-documented, including process flows, data dictionaries, and user guides. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.

• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

• Identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to construct recommendations for strategic/tactical sales plans

jobs.title: Australia & New Zealand Securities Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

jobs.title: Data Engineer-Python, Pyspark, sql, Databricks
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data engineering? Are you keen to manage data that can materially help teams improve the way they work? You have the opportunity to join the team working on the new DevLens initiative, an ambitious data initiative to help our 40,000 IT employees organization accelerate value delivery to customers, improve organization efficiency and developer experience. Together with your team you will contribute to building and maintaining innovative data products spanning all engineering activities across UBS IT lines of business.

You will work with large delta tables on Azure Databricks with Dagster, AKS, PySpark & SparkSQL, Confluent Kafka, REST APIs, database platforms, serving data products on Starburst/Trino data mesh.

We’re looking for a passionate Data Engineer to:
• Develop, support and improve data pipelines and data products with attention to governance including sourcing, lineage, modelling, security, quality, distribution and efficiency
• Automate testing & deployment where possible using CI/CD pipelines
• Build observability to monitor and resolve production issues
• Analyse and organize raw data and be able to combine multiple datasets of varying quality
• Take ownership and drive deliveries within a supportive team environment
• Follow engineering best practices, and ensure bank & regulatory compliance across the lifecycle
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions, promote re-use where possible.
• Help manage the department data inventory and data products
• Provide data support to internal & external stakeholders
• Be comfortable within a geographically spread, fast-moving Agile team
• Continuously up-skill, learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

• Write comprehensive validation reports, documenting the assessments to required standards
• Collaborate effectively with stakeholders globally to understand / challenge potential model risks; communicate validation findings to relevant stakeholders
• Support ongoing review of model performance and model change reviews to ensure models remain fit for purpose

jobs.description:
Sind Sie eine initiative, kontaktfreudige Persönlichkeit? Und laufen Sie zur Hochform auf, wenn Sie Kunden und Kundinnen mit Hilfe der neusten Technologien beraten?

Dann nehmen Sie doch mit uns Kontakt auf. Wir suchen eine Kollegin oder einen Kollegen, die/der ein Flair für die Anliegen der Kundschaft hat und sich in der digitalen Welt wohl fühlt.

Und das sind Ihre Kernaufgaben:
• Sie erfassen die vielseitigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Kundinnen präzis und beraten sie kompetent.
• Sie betreuen und bearbeiten nach einer umfassenden Einarbeitungszeit ein eigenes Kundenportefeuille mit Anlage- und Hypothekarkunden.
• Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für optimale Lösungen. Damit sichern Sie Kundenbeziehungen langfristig und punkten bei Neukunden und Neukundinnen.
• Bei Ihrer Beratung setzen Sie auch auf innovative Tools und Apps. So nehmen Sie die Kundschaft auf unsere Reise in die Zukunft mit: Sie ermuntern sie, unsere digitalen Produkte einzusetzen und unterstützen Sie dabei.

Questo è il modo di portare i vostri clienti nel nostro viaggio nel futuro: li incoraggiate a utilizzare i nostri prodotti digitali e supportarli in questo modo.
